alternate_reviews.source_file: 005 - I Stayed In Elywnn Until I Earned A WoW Token ... It Was Cursed  - Goldbound Episode 5.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: Full alternate track reviewed independently. Same events as original; paraphrased/translated captions introduce naming errors and token-drop wording error. Clarifies41glyphs times50g=2050g. Canonical original retained.

alternate_reviews.source_file: 033 - I Tried Earning A WoW Token In DUSTWALLOW... The Skinning Was INSANE - Goldbound Ep.32.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: All46paragraphs reviewed independently. Same events; extensive translated name corruption. Alternate P30 says67ThickLeather where primary saysThickHide; retained as ambiguity. Alternate P39 mistakenly says24000gHatchling despite2.4k earlier; primary consistent2400retained.

alternate_reviews.source_file: 034 - I Rolled A Zone Where Drops Are Worth MILLIONS - Goldbound Ep.33.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: All42paragraphs independently reviewed; same experiments. Alternate incorrectly says12000raw Uldaman/h versus original1200; extensive translated names, duplicated incorrect mythic786caption. Prefer original1200 and preserve gear ambiguity.

alternate_reviews.source_file: 035 - I Went Looking For WoW’s Forgotten 9,999,999g Item - Goldbound Ep.34.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: All38paragraphs independently reviewed; same events. Confirms twoMossAgates and clarifies hypothetical next-alt Mulgore, mistranscribedMalGanisoriginal. Still repeats3.1thread arithmetic error; no numerical conflict resolution.

alternate_reviews.source_file: 036 - How I Accidentally Found WoW's S-Tier Gold Farm Zone - Goldbound 35.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: All38paragraphs reviewed independently. AlternateP21namesKrikks as Silithid Ripper rare; primary missing name. Alternate corrupts400000bank savings to1000and omits14857raw; primary retained. Same events.

alternate_reviews.source_file: 037 - I Finally Rolled A Death Zone - Goldbound 36.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: All21paragraphs reviewed independently; same events, translated item and zone names unreliable. No additional quantitative test results.

alternate_reviews.source_file: 038 - This Buff Just Changed Everything - Goldbound 37.en.vtt
alternate_reviews.notes: All28paragraphs reviewed independently; same events. Alternate badly corrupts Shard of Fozruk pet as Fragment of Azzinoth; primary pet provenance retained. No additional farms or tests.

alternate_evidence.file: 036 - How I Accidentally Found WoW's S-Tier Gold Farm Zone - Goldbound 35.en.vtt
alternate_evidence.quote: That is, we have already found blue things that become personal when worn, but there have been no epic ones yet. And we've been playing for over 45 days. Besides, the Rod of Jordan is a pretty good thing. Of course, there are better options, like the Skullfire Shield. But hey, these guys are proving their worth. Even if a mob doesn't look the best on paper, we always have a chance of dropping epic loot. So far, Thousand Needles is living up to expectations. But that's probably all there is to see underwater. Although, in fact, there are a few rare enemies here. The most notable of these is Krikks, who drops a good weapon for transmogrification: the Silithid Ripper. This is a one-handed weapon with a market value of over 100,000 gold, but that's just the market price. Given the data across all servers and recent sales, it will likely go for significantly less, but it's worth checking.
